name: Herla

attributes.attribute: ancient king trapped in the Otherworld who roams Herefordshire as a tiny half-animal man astride a large goat
doomed to lead the Wild Hunt, called Herla's Rade, on moonlit nights

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Herla is a being of British folklore. In Herefordshire people believed an ancient king roamed the land. His name was Herla. He appeared as a tiny half-animal man. He rode a large goat. He had been trapped in the Otherworld centuries before. His duty was to lead the Wild Hunt. The hunt was called Herla's Rade. It ran on moonlit nights. Some sources say he passed this duty to the English king. He then rested in the Otherworld.
objective: Document Herla, the leader of the Wild Hunt in British folklore.
